proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ H _ _ _ T hT hs h0
  have hsym := ContinuousLinearMap.isSelfAdjoint_iff_isSymmetric.mp hs
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  apply h0
  rw [← T.eq_zero_of_forall_hasEigenvalue_eq_zero hT hsym]
  intro μ he
  by_contra hμ
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := he.exists_hasEigenvector
  exact hn μ x hμ hx.2 (Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hx.1)
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H] [CompleteSpace H] (T : H →L[𝕜] H), IsCompactOperator T → ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T = T → T ≠ 0 → ∃ (μ : 𝕜) (x : H), μ ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ 0 ∧ T x = μ • x
